filtration_requirement: For flows below 3 gpm or any Landscape Drip application, use a 200 mesh filter installed upstream.
pressure_regulation: Rain Bird residential valves cannot be used with PRS pressure regulating modules.
compatibility_notes: Works with standard sprinkler timers and accepts the Rain Bird TBOS latching solenoid. Compatible with ESP-LXIVM two-wire systems when used with IVMSOL; not recommended for other two-wire systems.
performance_table_reference: DV and DVF Valve Pressure Loss (psi), revision not stated, https://www.rainbird.com/sites/default/files/media/documents/2020-09/dv-and-dvf-100-dv-angle-mxb-valve-pressure-loss-and-performance-charts.pdf
notes: Flow-control, 1 inch NPT female-by-female model. The current product page links a DV Series Valves Tech Spec revised 6/17; the separate official pressure-loss chart does not print a revision date.
